result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.subgraph_enrichment()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Test whether a subgraph is enriched for a categorical node attribute. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L14286-L14417){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.subgraph_enrichment( subgraph_nodes, attribute, target_value=None, method="hypergeometric", ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Given a set of nodes (e.g., a detected community), tests whether they contain more nodes with a particular attribute value than expected by chance compared to the full graph. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [subgraph_nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node IDs defining the subgraph to test. [attribute]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Name of the categorical node attribute to test (e.g., `"pathway"`, `"go_term"`). [target_value]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | int | float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Specific attribute value to test enrichment for. If `None`, tests each distinct value separately and returns results for all. [method]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["hypergeometric"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Statistical test to use: `"hypergeometric"` (default) or `"chi_squared"`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `target_value` is specified, returns a dict with keys: `"value"`, `"k"` (hits in subgraph), `"K"` (hits in graph), `"n"` (subgraph size), `"N"` (graph size), `"p_value"`, `"fold_enrichment"`. If `target_value` is `None`, returns a dict mapping each attribute value to its enrichment result dict. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#2acaba46 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="G1") .add_node(label="G2") .add_node(label="G3") .add_node(label="G4") .add_node(label="G5") .add_node(label="G6") .add_edge("G1", "G2") .add_edge("G2", "G3") .add_edge("G3", "G1") .add_edge("G4", "G5") .add_edge("G5", "G6") .add_edge("G6", "G4") ) pathways = {"G1": "apoptosis", "G2": "apoptosis", "G3": "apoptosis", "G4": "signaling", "G5": "signaling", "G6": "apoptosis"} graph.set_node_attrs( "pathway", {graph.get_id_from_label(g): p for g, p in pathways.items()} ) subgraph = [graph.get_id_from_label(g) for g in ["G1", "G2", "G3"]] result = graph.subgraph_enrichment(subgraph, "pathway", "apoptosis") result["fold_enrichment"], result["p_value"] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (1.5, 0.2) ``` ::: :::
